body:
Over the weekend, cryptocurrency markets showed limited movement with Bitcoin falling below $84,000 to $83,900 and Ether trading at $2,688. Despite Bitcoin's slight dip, total market capitalization rose marginally by 0.3% to $2.989 trillion. DeFi tokens outperformed, with QI surging over 100%, QUICK up nearly 33%, and several others like AERO, VELODROME, and ENA posting double-digit gains. Other altcoins such as PHA and ARK also saw significant increases, indicating selective strength in the [...] Following the weekend's mixed crypto movements, Bitcoin trades slightly down by 0.39% at Rp1.507.302.739 on Pluang as of Sep 26, 2026 08:41 WIB. DeFi tokens show strong momentum, with QI up 59.01% to Rp67 and QUICK rising 27.03% to Rp220. Aerodrome Finance (AERO) also posts a notable 20.60% gain, trading at Rp15.082. These figures highlight selective buying interest in DeFi assets despite Bitcoin's minor dip.
